replies.author: Doppelganger_
replies.body:
This map is like a fusion of RFV2 and 3. (which is not a bad thing)

Can you please post in the op the starting inventory kit and how many players per team. 

Some ways this map can be improved:
  • I do feel like in the yml you need to add limits on far you can bridge to the left and right. I think U-Bridging could be an issue.
  • Also the map seems a bit small. From spawn to the front lines is a bit too close. I feel like the whole map can be enlarged. (I don't how any players you were intending to have per team). 

I can give more criticism once I you give us the information above.

replies.author: PictureFrames
replies.body:
Guys, although it may look similar to an OCN map, we can't criticize them for "looking like OCN." They're blocks. Certain blocks, put into a certain shape, put into a certain game mode. Unless it was a direct copy of RFV2, or any OCN map at all, we shouldn't be criticizing it because it "looks too much like OCN" There's no "OCN" and "Avicus" categories for the way a map looks. Just give a little more constructive criticism, rather than just categorizing it as "An OCN" based map.

Although I really like the design. It's very different from anything I've played on, and I think it will make PVPing really fun. +1

replies.author: ViceTechnicolour
replies.body:
I will just keep it related to the post since this is what it's toward. You had no exact or direct intention of saying what you said other than to anger the map maker. Now that she seems to be scared off, I'd like to say that saying #OCN is NOT a proper post, and saying that it resembles it isn't even in the slightest bit contributing. #OCN comes off as obnoxious, annoying, and offensive in the sense of thinking that the OP copied a map.

It would have been better if you instead listed points to make it original and say that it was in the slightest bit good in your original post. Saying #OCN does not imply that it's good, doesn't imply it as a contribution to the map, or anything. You just said a hashtag and the name of a server. 

As for the OP, since there's a download and YML and stuff, I suppose it's accepted. Eric, please be more positive in the future and don't do that. This goes for everyone else who questioned the map's originality in an offensive way. TheLuxeHD provided good points for a map and appreciation goes toward Aversively for cleaning up stuff.
